REF1: Wide shot, eye-level, establishing view of the empty kitchen set. Charcoal stove with the aluminum pot at centre-left, teak counter with round board and white enamel bowls at right, tiled wall behind, a window at far left pouring golden morning light across the room. No people, no food, a thin wisp of steam rising from the pot.
REF2: Close-up, slightly high angle, hero shot of five raw giant river prawns lying side by side on the round tamarind-wood chopping board, wet and glossy with water droplets, orange tomalley glowing through the translucent grey-blue head shells, long blue claws stretched forward. Soft window light from the left, blurred kitchen behind. No people, nothing cooked.
REF3: Close-up, slightly high three-quarter angle, hero shot of the finished prawn rice soup in the rooster bowl on the teak counter: golden broth, soft rice, three curled orange-striped prawns, fried garlic, thin ginger strips, cilantro, sliced spring onion, white pepper specks. Gentle steam drifts upward through morning window light, ceramic spoon resting beside. No people.
REF4: Medium close-up, eye-level, frontal portrait of the Thai woman cook standing behind the teak counter, shoulders and head framed centrally, relaxed upright posture, hands out of frame. Neutral friendly expression, mouth relaxed and slightly open, eyes looking straight ahead. Soft window light on her face, tiled wall and blurred charcoal stove behind her.

img.P01: Medium close-up, eye-level, chef standing behind the teak counter, centred, smiling warmly with mouth relaxed and slightly open as if about to speak, eyes looking straight ahead.
